text: Quick start across Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, CLI, REST API, or Web UI
quote: Get your first parse job running in under a minute—whether you prefer Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, the CLI, the REST API, or the Web UI.

text: Agentic, layout-aware OCR turns PDFs, scans, tables and charts into clean markdown, text or JSON
quote: Parse is an agentic document parser built for LLM pipelines—layout-aware OCR that turns PDFs, scans, tables, and charts into clean markdown, text, or JSON.

text: LlamaExtract API pulls structured data out of unstructured PDFs, text files and images
quote: LlamaExtract provides a simple API for extracting structured data from unstructured documents like PDFs, text files, and images.

text: Classify automatically categorizes documents into user-defined types using natural-language rules
quote: Classify lets you automatically categorize documents into types you define (for example: invoice, receipt, contract) using natural-language rules.

text: Split API automatically segments concatenated PDFs into logical document sections
quote: The Split API provides a simple way to automatically segment concatenated PDFs into logical document sections based on content categories.

text: Configurable webhooks notify you when jobs complete, fail, or change state instead of polling
quote: Instead of continuously polling for status updates, you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states.

text: Entire platform can be self-hosted (BYOC) within your own infrastructure, keeping data and models under your control

text: Official MCP endpoint exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split and Index as callable tools for any MCP client
quote: https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp is the endpoint that exposes the platform's document processing — Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index — as tools any MCP client can call.

text: SSO and role-based access controls manage access to organizations and projects
quote: Identity and access. Use SSO and role-based access controls to manage access to your organization and projects.

text: Supports over 130 file formats across four categories
quote: LlamaParse supports 130+ file formats across four categories.

text: Extract tables directly into pandas DataFrames with source-page provenance for each value
quote: pull every table out into pandas DataFrames with source-page provenance, and turn on Cost Optimizer to keep costs down on long mixed-complexity documents

text: Drag-and-drop a document in the web UI, define a schema, and extract data with no code
quote: Just define your Extraction Configuration (schema and settings), drag and drop any supported document into LlamaParse and extract data from your documents.

text: Build a hosted vector search/index pipeline for retrieval-augmented generation
quote: Build a hosted vector search pipeline for RAG

text: Single API key and SDK give access to all five composable products (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index)
quote: One API key, one SDK, and five composable products: Parse (agentic OCR), Extract (structured data), Classify, Split, and Index.

text: Agent-oriented documentation tools: lexical search, regex grep, and full-page read for AI agents
quote: search_docs — a basic lexical search using BM25 2. grep_docs — exact search using regex 3. read_doc — provides an interface to read the entire contents of any given page path

text: Enriched forms pass returns each form page as structured JSON with field values, checkbox states and bounding boxes
quote: Turn on the enriched forms pass to get each form page as structured JSON — fields with values, checkbox states, and bounding boxes — and read it back with expand=forms.

text: Cost Optimizer setting reduces processing cost on long, mixed-complexity documents
quote: turn on Cost Optimizer to keep costs down on long mixed-complexity documents

text: Parses complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes and images into clean markdown
quote: Turn even the most complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes, and images into clean markdown

quote: Enterprise readiness, deployment & data residency: "managed SaaS, single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints" — the platform documents self-hosting and regional deployment options alongside the managed cloud.
